title: Agroforestry for Landscape Restoration in Semi-Arid Africa and South Asia
content: Farmer-managed natural regeneration (FMNR) of native trees in degraded semi-arid cropland increases above-ground biomass by 2.0-4.5 tonnes/ha/yr, raises soil organic nitrogen by 18-30%, and supports a 55% increase in below-ground microbial functional diversity.
